correctness.rationale: An open rich-edge witness requires four distinct neighbor colors and a fifth for the witness itself. I checked all 126 edges in the seven printed base tables directly from modular rim/rung adjacency with python3 /workspace/checks/prism_certificates.py. Counts of rich edges for n=3,...,9 were 3,6,6,8,9,11,12; every edge has an open rich neighbor. Each line-graph step shifts an edge anchor by at most one column, so the required edge and neighbor-of-neighbor data lie in five columns, also for n=5 with cyclic indices. In concatenations of length-5/6/7 blocks no five-column window crosses two seams, and the common four-column prefix makes each seam window exactly a tested window of the preceding cyclic block. The bases of lengths 10,...,14 plus any number of length-five blocks exhaust n≥10. The uploaded checker was inspected, not run.
